chapter_seo_title: Mortal Stream Sect Entry: The Cold Calculus of Evaluation - Chapter 609
chapter_meta_description: Han Li enters the Falling Cloud Sect's second round of selection. He and a few high-layer cultivators begin their evaluation, while Han Li's tactical mind profiles his new peers for hidden dangers.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Chapter 609 – The Sect's Selective Sorting
og_description: Han Li survives the first cut and enters the elite batch. As he sizes up his fellow candidates, he senses a hidden, sinister coldness in one burly man.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 609: Han Li's Perfect Audit of New Peers
twitter_description: The Falling Cloud Sect's selection machine grinds on. Han Li's not just being evaluated; he's already built tactical profiles on his competition.

lore_anchors.definition: A major cultivation sect based in the Yunmeng Mountain range, known for its strict entry requirements and powerful defensive formations.
The name of the Falling Cloud Sect's core mountain gate, a hidden paradise within a vast mist formation.
